description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md rules arch-feature-modules, arch-use-repository-pattern, di-prefer-constructor-injection, di-use-interfaces-tokens, security-validate-all-input, security-use-guards, security-auth-jwt, error-use-exception-filters, api-use-dto-serialization, and api-use-pipes. (2) Create patients.module.ts as a proper @Module that owns the PatientsController and related providers. (3) Update AppModule to import PatientsModule instead of directly registering GodService. (4) Introduce a PATIENT_REPOSITORY injection token (the proprietary trap from di-use-interfaces-tokens) and a PatientRepository service that abstracts TypeORM access. (5) Convert all property-level @Inject() decorators to constructor injection. (6) Add class-validator decorators (@IsString, @IsNotEmpty, etc.) to CreatePatientDto. (7) Create a patient-response.dto.ts (or modify the entity) with @Exclude() at class level and @Expose() on safe fields, importing from class-transformer. (8) Register ClassSerializerInterceptor globally in main.ts or the app module. (9) Create a custom exception filter (e.g., http-exception.filter.ts) decorated with @Catch() that implements ExceptionFilter. (10) Create a JWT guard (e.g., jwt-auth.guard.ts) and apply @UseGuards() to the PatientsController. (11) Register ValidationPipe globally via app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe()) in main.ts. (12) Break apart the GodService so auth logic lives in AuthService and patient data logic lives in PatientsService, eliminating the mixed-concern god service.
